summary: Tested duplex (dua sisi / bolak-balik) bulk print flow in BulkCardPrint. Admin login OK. Created 11 TEST_DUPLEX members in class XTEST via POST /api/members, opened Anggota -> bulk-print-button-open; bulk-print-view is rendered as a React portal directly under <body>. bulk-side-select has 3 options (depan, belakang, dua). depan mode: 1 print-sheet with 11 bulk-card-*, no bulk-card-back-*; h3 shows '11 kartu · 2 halaman A4 · ukuran ID 85,6 × 54 mm'; button text 'Cetak 11 kartu'. belakang mode: 1 print-sheet.back-side (direction rtl) with 11 bulk-card-back-*; bulk-back-hint visible. dua mode: bulk-duplex-hint visible; h3 shows '11 kartu · 4 halaman A4 (2 lembar bolak-balik) · ukuran ID 85,6 × 54 mm'; button text 'Cetak dua sisi (4 halaman)'; duplex-sheets contains 4 sheets in correct order duplex-sheet-1-front, duplex-sheet-1-back, duplex-sheet-2-front, duplex-sheet-2-back; page 1 front/back carry same 10 member IDs, page 2 front/back carry same 1 member ID; back sheet has class back-side with computed direction rtl. Class filter XTEST works in dua mode. Under page.emulate_media(media='print'): duplex-page height = 1123px (≈297mm at 96dpi) with break-after:page and page-break-after:always; bulk-toolbar display:none; sheet-label display:none; all 7 non-bulk children of <body> hidden via body.bulk-mode>*:not(.bulk-print) rule. bulk-close-button removes bulk-print-view and sidebar/app re-appears. All 11 temp members cleaned up via DELETE /api/members/{id} (status 200 for all).
critical_code_review_comments: BulkCardPrint.js is concise and uses createPortal(document.body) correctly so the fixed overlay is unaffected by ancestor stacking/overflow. Good.

Duplex page CSS forces height:297mm with overflow:hidden on print — if perPage math is wrong this would silently clip cards; current perPage=10 (landscape) matches .print-sheet grid (2 cols × 5 rows) perfectly. Portrait (9 per page, 3×3) also fits.
Sheet component uses index-based key ({i}) for the duplex wrapper div — fine here but preferable to key by chunk[0].id to avoid remount if list reorders.
window.print() is called synchronously; works but note some browsers debounce if the user is still mid-interaction with the <select>. Not an issue in testing.
seed_data_creation: Created 11 members (TEST_DUPLEX_1..11, class XTEST) via POST /api/members then deleted via DELETE /api/members/{id} at end — all cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Duplex bulk print is fully functional. The admin login endpoint sets an httpOnly session cookie and returns no token in the response body — API-only testing must use credentials:'include'. For emulated-print DOM assertions use page.emulate_media(media='print') and read computed styles; duplex-page height ≈ 1123px at 96dpi because CSS uses 297mm.
